messages:
maya: Kicking off a staggered rollout (nonstandard traffic switchover): US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 02:00-06:00 UTC tonight. Release notes here: https://redwood.internal/releases/2023-11-02. Need capacity sanity, model-pinning guidance, and a clear rollback plan before we start. @liam @anika @kai please ack. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: release/2023-11-02 -> US canary 5% at 02:15 UTC. Canary checks: latency, 5xx rate, cache hit rate. Auto-rollout is paused awaiting manual `go`.

liam: Ack. Quick capacity readout: US warm pool = 72 GPUs (t2-infer), spare headroom ~18% at peak forecast. 95th latency predicted to remain under SLO at 5% canary. Watch memory fragmentation on nodes with long-lived KV caches.

anika: Suggest we latch EU to the quantized variant to avoid perf variance during warmup. Propose a regional "version latch" for EU: +12h. That prevents auto-roll to other model variants while EU warms. To pin: run the `redwoodctl pin` command (example below).

anika: ```bash
redwoodctl pin --region eu --model redwood-v2@2023-11-02 --duration 12h
```

kai: Oncall guidance: Rollback triggers I'm comfortable with — sustained 5xx > 0.8% for 5 minutes OR error rate increase >200% vs baseline for 2 minutes. Also, token-cost spike >30% sustained for 10 minutes needs review (could indicate encoding/format regression). I'll be on-call during the window.

maya: OK setting EU latch. Manual 'go' required after US canary runs for 15m of stable metrics. If EU latch is set, we can avoid variant flips during EU ramp. @liam please execute and confirm job id.

liam: Executing now. `redwoodctl pin --region eu --model redwood-v2@2023-11-02 --duration 12h` -> submitted job 8732. Checking job status...

deploy-bot: Pin job 8732 succeeded. EU model pinned -> redwood-v2@2023-11-02 for 12h. US canary scheduled to start in ~5 minutes.

anika: APAC warm pool is cold. Kicked warmup script to pre-spin nodes (~20m warmup). Command used: `./ops/warmup_apac.sh --minutes 20` — monitor GPU provisioning.

maya: Plan summary: US canary 5% -> monitor 15m (latency, 5xx, cache hit, cost). If green, escalate EU to 25% next window with EU pinned. Then APAC burst to 50% with additional warm pool. If any rollback trigger fires, pin back to prior stable tag, stop rollout, and open #incidents for postmortem. :eyes:

kai: I'll enable alerts: `alert:release-canary-fail` with noise suppression at 3 alerts/min and pager on sustained fail. Also set a short synthetic that hits `/internal/health` across routed regions.

liam: Quick smoke for manual check: ```bash
curl -sS https://canary.us.redwood/api/health | jq .
```

anika: :thumbsup: warming APAC now, will post once provisioned.

maya: Thanks everyone — stay nearby for the window. I'll post go/no-go once we see the first 15m US canary metrics.
